d:
Embark with us on a Bari to Albania overnight ferry adventure as we sail across the Adriatic Sea from Bari, Italy to Durres, Albania. In this travel vlog, we take you through the complete ferry experience—from boarding, exploring the ship, enjoying the views, and touring my luxury cabin room—all the way to arriving in Albania the next morning.
Once we reach the Port of Durres, we pick up our rental car and start an exciting road trip to Ksamil Albania, one of the country’s most beautiful coastal destinations known for its turquoise waters, stunning beaches, and scenic drive.
